purpose: This command-line entry point chooses execution depth from task classification and manual flags. It adds conversation and routing context, supports project registration, applies mode and cost controls, and dispatches tier 0 through tier 3 work to the corresponding EO pipeline.
side_effects: LLM calls through classifiers and agents
summary: Routes CLI tasks through SGA, cache, classification, panel escalation, and tier-specific execution pipelines.
